whatWeDoText: Engineering services offered include: FERC filing assistance, feasibility studies, preliminary engineering, FEED (Front End Engineering Design) engineering, detail design, construction management, start-up and commissioning support. TKE personnel have considerable experience in all phases of a project and have worked with several different client systems for project management and controls and are flexible to adapt to whatever system the client wishes to implement on their projects.
aboutText: TKE Engineering & Design, Inc. is a medium sized consulting engineering company which has been serving the gas and pipeline industry for 30+ years. The company was started in Houston, Texas in 1992 by Terry Eleiott. TKE performs engineering and design services for projects throughout the continental United States.
